roles.title: Parwah | Founder
roles.sub: Family-care platform for India, built end to end; alongside it, independent AI products.
bullets: Built Parwah, live in India.
Owned discovery, UX and engineering so relatives in different cities coordinate a parent's care through shared tasks, documents and parent-controlled permissions.
Lifecycle OS.
Designed and built a 16-module D2C marketing platform with a 90-day campaign-planning workflow, from audience analysis to briefs and creative production.
The Third Eye.
Built a personal AI assistant with retrieval memory, tool calling and voice-driven task execution.
Mailer Architect.
Built a multi-model workflow with catalogue-aware product selection and provider fallbacks that turns campaign briefs into brand-aligned HTML emails.

roles.title: VAHDAM India | AGM, Product Management & D2C Growth
roles.sub: D2C product strategy, conversion optimisation and lifecycle growth across US, UK and global markets.
bullets: Funnel-first roadmap.
Used funnel analysis to prioritise improvements to purchase journeys, conversion and lifecycle CRM.
One retention workflow.
Connected customer analytics, segmentation, campaign planning and email production; Klaviyo and WebEngage experiments contributed to UK marketing revenue growth within two months.

roles.title: Times Internet | Senior Product Manager
roles.sub: Consumer subscriptions, revenue and growth across ET Prime, ET Markets, Times Health+ and the Times Internet Half Marathon.
roles.previous_roles: Promoted twice in under three years: APM (Jun 2022) → PM (Sep 2023) → Senior PM (Apr 2025)
bullets: 5× Assisted Sales revenue.

ET Prime's assisted channel was stuck at ₹15L a month. I redesigned lead journeys and call flows, ran continuous A/B tests and built an AI telesuite for call scoring and pitch help: ₹80L a month in four months, ROI above 400% in six months and the ET Prime Team Award (2025). Also owned growth and monetisation for TOI Plus.
Delhi Half Marathon, 0 to 1.
Owned discovery, registration, acquisition funnels and on-ground runner insights for Times Internet's first consumer event IP at Dhyan Chand National Stadium: 18K+ runners and a new revenue stream.
Times Health+ paid tier from zero.
Launched paid wellness subscriptions through freemium-to-paid journeys, pricing experiments and retention-led monetisation, creating a new paid tier and revenue line.
ET Markets, rebuilt.

Led the web and mobile-web revamp: +27% engagement and ₹3Cr+ incremental annual revenue. App revamps lifted DAU 25% and session duration 15%; discovery and decision-support features lifted screen views 19%.
30 to 150+ qualified leads a day.
As APM, introduced assisted-buying surfaces for high-intent ET users; onboarding and engagement experiments improved subscriber retention by 10%.

earlier.title: Citymall | Software Engineer (SDE II)
bullets: Built and scaled backend systems supporting high-frequency consumer transactions on a consumer-commerce platform.
Improved data pipelines and API performance to support growth and reliability.

earlier.title: Tuple Technologies | Software Engineer & Product Owner
bullets: Appointed Product Owner for Chatter (now DebatabL), a live football commentary app; led the MVP from ideation to launch, driving early user engagement and adoption.
Built APIs and backend systems for consumer and hyperlocal commerce products.
Supported growth initiatives through onboarding, distribution and early go-to-market efforts.

skills: Discovery, strategy, roadmaps, prioritisation, A/B experimentation, pricing and monetisation.
Agents, RAG/pgvector, tool calling, model routing, Python, TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase.
Funnels, subscriptions, lifecycle CRM, SQL, Klaviyo, WebEngage, Mixpanel and Shopify.
